description: Cartografía BTA 1:5.000 (año de referencia 2023). Punto geodésico y punto GNSS is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by filescartografia.navarra.es. BTA layer (reference year 2023) containing the reference points of geodetic networks and satellite positioning networks for the entire territory of Navarre at a scale of 1:5,000. The BTA is an adaptation to the production of the National Cartographic Base (BCN) of the National Geographic Institute (IGN). BTA is the acronym for "Harmonized Topographic Base". Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Cartography BTA 1:5,000 (reference year 2023). Geodetic point and GNSS point" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Dataset público con descarga disponible, Sistemas de coordenadas de referencia. The listing shows 2024-11-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
